newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Perennial offers 60 mln shrs at HK$1.07 each.
newsitem.headline: HK's Perennial offers 60 mln shrs at HK$1.07 each.

text.p: Electrical cable manufacturer Perennial International Ltd said on Thursday it was offering 60 million shares at HK$1.07 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The offer includes an issue of 40 million new shares and the sale of 20 million existing shares, Perennial said in a statement.
The prospective weighted average and fully diluted price to earnings multiple is 5.67 times and 6.73 times, respectively, it said. The dividend yield is six percent.
The company will have a market capitalisation of HK$214 million and an adjusted net tangible asset value per share of 46.64 Hong Kong cents per share.
The IPO will run from December 13-18, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on December 30.
The new issue is sponsored and managed by Oriental Patron Asia Ltd and jointly sponsored by Nikko Securities (Asia) Ltd.

Perennial said the new issue will raise about HK$36.8 million after expenses, of which HK$15 million will be used to boost production capacity and buy machinery. The balance will be used to repay bank borrowing and for working capital.
Perennial forecast a profit of not less than HK$30.5 million for the year ending on December 31, 1996, following actual net profit of HK$15.4 million for the first six months of 1996.
It posted after-tax profit of HK$21.9 million for the year ended December 31, 1995, compared with HK$24.3 million in 1994 and HK$16.4 million in 1993.
